description: Defines a template class StorageBlock for managing data blocks in disk cache, including memory management, sharing, and serialization.

classes.name: StorageBlock
classes.description: A template class managing a data block within disk cache, supporting sharing, lazy initialization, and integrity checks.

methods.name: StorageBlock
methods.description: Constructor initializing StorageBlock with file and address.

methods.name: CopyFrom
methods.description: Deep copies data from another StorageBlock.

methods.name: buffer
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the data buffer.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the size of the data buffer.

methods.name: offset
methods.description: Returns the offset of the block.

methods.name: LazyInit
methods.description: Initializes the StorageBlock lazily with file and address.

methods.name: SetData
methods.description: Sets internal storage to share memory with another instance.

methods.name: Discard
methods.description: Deletes data, owns the buffer, even if modified.

methods.name: StopSharingData
methods.description: Stops sharing data with another object.

methods.name: set_modified
methods.description: Marks the data as modified for lazy saving.

methods.name: clear_modified
methods.description: Clears the modified flag.

methods.name: Data
methods.description: Returns a pointer to internal storage, allocates if needed.

methods.name: HasData
methods.description: Checks if data is associated.

methods.name: VerifyHash
methods.description: Verifies the integrity of the data via hash.

methods.name: own_data
methods.description: Checks if the object owns the data buffer.

methods.name: address
methods.description: Returns the address of the block.

methods.name: Load
methods.description: Loads data from storage.

methods.name: Store
methods.description: Stores data to storage.

methods.name: Load (with callback)
methods.description: Loads data with callback support.

methods.name: Store (with callback)
methods.description: Stores data with callback support.
